title: #inc-2168: July payout batch delayed by a provider outage

messages.text: [FIRING:1] PayoutBatchLate (namespace=payouts cluster=prod-us-east severity=warning)
INC-2168 declared by @nd. Sev2. Payout batch delayed, investigating.
on it. checking the batch worker and provider calls now
i'm looking at the worker logs. seeing a run start at 06:00, then a bunch of provider failures after 06:10
i can pull batch state from psql if needed. want me to check how many rows got through before it stopped?

replies.text: yes please, row counts would help

messages.text: `kubectl --context prod-us-east -n payouts logs deploy/payouts-worker --since=30m | tail -n 80`

replies.text: same output here, lots of timeout and upstream error lines from the provider client

messages.text: `psql -h pg-payouts -U payouts_ro -d payouts -c "select count(*) from payout_rows where batch_id = '2026-07-15';"`
looks like 17,503 completed, 939 still pending in this batch

replies.text: ok, so it did stop after partial progress. no data weirdness so far

messages.text: i'm checking whether the worker exited cleanly or got wedged. don't think it's a db issue, no retries hammering anything right now
found it, safety stop tripped at 5 percent failure rate. worker exited cleanly, no immediate restart
good, that's at least contained. i'm watching the pending rows and provider status, but there's nothing to rerun yet
agreed. i'd rather not force retries while the provider is still failing. we can wait a bit and see if it clears on its own
still seeing failures on fresh attempts. keeping the batch paused for now

replies.text: yep, no point poking it more. i'll keep an eye on support pings

messages.text: quick check, worker is still down and batch state hasn't changed. no signs of duplicate work
support already asked once. i told them we're waiting on the payment provider and will rerun once it recovers
[FIRING:1] PayoutBatchLate (namespace=payouts cluster=prod-us-east severity=warning)
yep, that confirms the batch still hasn't finished. status is unchanged from our side
checked the provider-facing errors again. still looks external, not our db or queue. no useful retry window yet
another creator ping came in. i'm keeping it vague, saying payout processing is delayed and we'll update when the batch completes
anyone seeing the provider come back? i still get failures on a few manual checks

replies.text: not yet. i'll keep checking every few minutes

messages.text: looks like provider errors are clearing now. i'm getting successful responses again
ok, let's hold a few mins and then rerun the remaining batch rows. i don't want to bounce straight back into another partial run

replies.text: makes sense. i can watch the remaining count and confirm no new failures

messages.text: restarting the batch now for the remaining 939 rows
most of the rerun is through. no new provider issues so far
down to the last chunk. everything still looks clean in psql
batch finished successfully. all rows completed, no duplicates, no manual fixes
nice. i'm going to keep watching for a few mins in case anything else shakes loose, but this looks done
posted the status update in oncall-payouts. support can point people there now
